column1: # note: The Schedule of Tax Computation (page 27) taxes the first $10,000 at 0% and the remaining balance at 4.4%; "Tax Rates" (page 22) says the same. Mississippi prints no tax table.

# note: The schedule has a column for each spouse on a combined return, each with its own first $10,000. These rows are for one column, the taxpayer's: a single, head of family or separate filer, or a joint return with all income in column A.
# note: Each row is repeated for the filing statuses the Form 80-105 offers: single, married joint or combined (mfj), married filing separate returns (mfs) and head of family (hoh).
# note: Amounts are rounded to the nearest whole dollar (page 22).
